name: codex-limit-bar
description: A lightweight native macOS menu bar utility for local Codex usage limits.
author: Sergey Kosten

scripts.build: xcodebuild -project CodexLimitBar.xcodeproj -scheme CodexLimitBar -configuration Release -derivedDataPath .build/DerivedData CODE_SIGNING_ALLOWED=NO build
scripts.test: xcodebuild -project CodexLimitBar.xcodeproj -scheme CodexLimitBar -configuration Debug -derivedDataPath .build/DerivedData CODE_SIGNING_ALLOWED=NO test
